name: Should I try to repair historic millwork myself or hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Should I try to repair historic millwork myself or hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor cosmetic issues might be addressed by an experienced DIYer, historic millwork restoration often requires specialized skills, tools, and knowledge of period-appropriate techniques and materials. Improper repairs can devalue the millwork or cause further damage. A practical tradeoff is the risk of damaging irreplaceable original features versus the investment in professional expertise that ensures proper preservation and long-term integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional restoration is recommended for historic millwork due to specialized skills and tools required; improper DIY can cause damage.
